effects.name: Fantasy lightning
effects.description: Blue electric glows chase every step, with crackling sparks.

effects.name: Fantasy bubbles
effects.description: Soft blue bubbles gather under each step and pop into sparkles.

effects.name: Firework sparks
effects.description: Golden sparks burst out wherever guests land.

effects.name: Bursting hearts
effects.description: Clouds of little red hearts spill out of every step.

effects.name: Snow flurry
effects.description: Icy glows and snowflakes swirl along behind the dancers.

effects.name: Starry sky
effects.description: Bright starlight trails and twinkles follow each step.

effects.name: Magic splashes
effects.description: Violet and pink sparkles splash up under every foot.

effects.name: Galaxy dust
effects.description: Green and gold stardust drifts in clouds around the dancers.

effects.name: Light spots
effects.description: Bright aqua spots of light trail along every path.

effects.name: Comet trails
effects.description: Aqua and gold comets streak along behind each step, with floating rings.

effects.name: Rolling suns
effects.description: Blazing little suns roll along wherever guests walk.

effects.name: Floating squares
effects.description: Outlined squares pop up and drift around each footstep.

effects.name: Fantasy shapes
effects.description: Neon stars, squares and dots in every colour scatter across the floor.

effects.name: Lotus blooms
effects.description: Lotus flowers and lily pads open up under each step, with koi swimming between.

effects.name: Rose petals
effects.description: Red rose petals scatter across the floor as guests walk through.

effects.name: Heart balloons
effects.description: A floor full of pink heart balloons that part as people walk through.

effects.name: Butterfly meadow
effects.description: Glowing flowers bloom and butterflies flutter up as guests walk through.

effects.name: Koi pond
effects.description: A lily pond full of koi that dart away from people's feet.

effects.name: Shooting stars
effects.description: Rainbow stars shoot out from every step, leaving bright trails.

effects.name: Flower sparkles
effects.description: Tiny glowing flowers in every colour burst up around each step.

effects.name: Magic crystals
effects.description: Golden green crystals glow in rings around each step.

effects.name: Music notes
effects.description: Colourful music notes bounce up from the dancers' feet.

effects.name: Balloon glow
effects.description: Glowing balloons in bright colours bob out from every step.

effects.name: Constellations
effects.description: A starry night where bright blue stars follow each guest, linked by constellation lines.

effects.name: Broken glass
effects.description: The floor seems to crack like glass under each step.

effects.name: Neon ribbons
effects.description: Glowing ribbons of coloured light swirl along behind every step.

effects.name: Coral reef
effects.description: A sunlit coral reef where shoals of bright tropical fish swim along with the dancers.

effects.name: Autumn leaves
effects.description: Red and golden maple leaves cover the floor and swirl up around each step.

effects.name: Blooming flowers
effects.description: Bright daisies and gerberas burst into bloom wherever guests walk.
